q1.explanationZh: relate 及物动词“叙述；讲”，relate sth. to sb.“向某人讲述某事”；作不及物动词“有关联”。

q2.explanationZh: related 形容词“有关的”，常用 be related to“与……有关”。

q3.explanationZh: relate 加 -ion 构成名词 relation“关系；关联”，in relation to“关于”。

q4.explanationZh: relation 加 -ship 构成 relationship“关系”，have a good relationship with sb.“与某人关系好”。

q5.explanationZh: relative 作名词“亲戚”，作形容词“相对的；有关的”，be relative to“与……有关”。

q6.explanationZh: relative 加 -ly 构成副词 relatively“相对地”，relatively speaking“相对而言”。

q7.explanationZh: relativity 名词“相对论；相对性”，the theory of relativity“相对论”。

q8.explanationZh: relax 动词“（使）放松”，relax oneself“放松自己”。

q9.explanationZh: relax 加 -ation 构成名词 relaxation“放松；消遣”。

q10.explanationZh: relay 作动词“转播”，作名词“接力赛”，a relay race“接力赛跑”。

q11.explanationZh: release 及物动词“释放；发布；（电影）公开发行”，注意结尾是 -ease。

q12.explanationZh: relevant 形容词“有关的；切题的”，be relevant to“与……有关”。

q13.explanationZh: rely 变 y 为 i 加 -able 构成 reliable“可靠的”，反义词 unreliable。

q14.explanationZh: relief 是名词“减轻；解除；宽慰”，动词形式是 relieve。

q15.explanationZh: relieve 是动词“减轻；使宽慰”，名词是 relief，注意 -ve 与 -f 的区别。

q16.explanationZh: religion 名词“宗教；宗教信仰”，形容词是 religious。

q17.explanationZh: religion 去掉 -on 加 -ous 构成形容词 religious“宗教的；虔诚的”。

q18.explanationZh: reluctant 形容词“不情愿的”，be reluctant to do sth.“不愿意做某事”。

q19.explanationZh: rely 是不及物动词，后接 on/upon：rely on sb./sth.“依靠……”。

q20.explanationZh: remain 不及物动词“留下；保持不变；尚待”，remain to be done“有待……”。

q21.explanationZh: remark 作动词“说；评论”，作名词“话语；评论”。

q22.explanationZh: remark 加 -able 构成形容词 remarkable“非凡的；显著的”。

q23.explanationZh: remember“记得；记住”，remember to do 记得要做，remember doing 记得做过。

q24.explanationZh: remind“提醒；使想起”，remind sb. of sth.“使某人想起某事”。

q25.explanationZh: remind 加 -er 构成名词 reminder“提醒者；起提醒作用的东西”。

q26.explanationZh: remote 形容词“遥远的；偏僻的”，a remote village“偏远的村子”。

q27.explanationZh: remove 及物动词“移开；去掉”，remove ... from ...“把……从……去掉”。

q28.explanationZh: re-（再）+ new（新）= renew“更新；重新开始”。

q29.explanationZh: rent 作名词“租金”，作动词“租借；出租”。

q30.explanationZh: repair 作动词“修理”，作名词“修理”，under repair“在修理中”。

q31.explanationZh: repeat 及物动词“重复；复述”，副词 repeatedly，名词 repetition。

q32.explanationZh: be relative to“与……有关；按……的比例”，relative 是形容词，前面要用 be。

q33.explanationZh: relieve ... from ...“解除（某人的病痛等）”，介词用 from。

q34.explanationZh: relieve sb. of ...“解除某人的负担、任务、责任等”，介词用 of。

q35.explanationZh: rely on/upon sb. to do“指望某人做……”，rely 后面用介词 on 或 upon。

q36.explanationZh: refer to“提到；查阅；把……归因于”，refer 是不及物动词，要接介词 to。

q37.explanationZh: rely on/upon sth.“指望……；依靠……”，on 和 upon 都可以。

q38.explanationZh: remain to do“尚待……”，如 remain to be solved“有待解决”。

q39.explanationZh: remember sth.“记起某件事”，remember 后直接接宾语。

q40.explanationZh: remember to do“记得去做（还没做的事）”，用不定式。

q41.explanationZh: remember doing“记得做过（已经做过的事）”，用动名词。

q42.explanationZh: give my regards to sb.“代我向某人问好”，regards 用复数。

q43.explanationZh: remove ... from ...“把……从……去掉”，介词用 from。

q44.explanationZh: under repair“在修理中”，介词用 under，repair 用单数。

q45.explanationZh: regardless of sth.“不管；不顾某事”，后接名词或动名词。

q46.explanationZh: rely on one’s own efforts“依靠自己的努力”，efforts 用复数。

q47.explanationZh: relate sth. to sb.“向某人讲述某事”，讲的是过去的事，用过去式 related。

q48.explanationZh: our 后接名词，“拜访亲戚”指不止一位，用复数 relatives。

q49.explanationZh: remain a mystery“仍然是个谜”，主语是 whether 从句，看作单数，用 remains。

q50.explanationZh: the theory of relativity“相对论”，介词 of 后用名词 relativity。

q51.explanationZh: an important 后接名词，“重要的提醒”用 reminder。

q52.explanationZh: to 后接动词原形，relax oneself“放松自己”。

q53.explanationZh: relieve sb. of sth.“解除某人的（痛苦）”，Will 后用动词原形 relieve。

q54.explanationZh: has been 后接形容词作表语，remarkable“出色的；非凡的”。

q55.explanationZh: 声音“被记住”，will be 后用过去分词 remembered 构成被动语态。

q56.explanationZh: 修饰 small city 用形容词，remote“偏远的”。

q57.sampleAnswer: Exercising every day not only improves physical fitness but also relieves stress.
references: Exercising every day not only improves physical fitness but also relieves stress.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “缓解压力”= relieve stress；主语是动名词 Exercising，谓语用单数 relieves；not only ... but also ...“不仅……而且……”。

q58.sampleAnswer: Although this classic film was first released in 1998, it still caused a huge response among fans when it was re-released this month.
references: Although this classic film was first released in 1998, it still caused a huge response among fans when it was re-released this month.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: 电影“上映”= be released（被动），“重新上映”= be re-released；although 后不再用 but。

q59.sampleAnswer: The grey-haired diplomat’s chance encounter with one of his old friends reminded him of their youth when they strove for their ideals.
references: The grey-haired diplomat’s chance encounter with one of his old friends reminded him of their youth when they strove for their ideals.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: remind sb. of sth.“使某人想起某事”；用“不期而遇”(chance encounter) 作主语，过去的事用 reminded。

q60.sampleAnswer: The mother sets the alarm clock for every six hours as a reminder to take her baby’s temperature.
references: The mother sets the alarm clock for every six hours as a reminder to take her baby’s temperature.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: as a reminder to do sth.“作为做某事的提醒”；“量体温”= take one’s temperature。

q61.sampleAnswer: In busy farming seasons, the small remote village seems deserted.
references: In busy farming seasons, the small remote village seems deserted.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “偏远的”= remote，放在名词 village 前；“显得空荡荡的”= seem deserted。

q62.sampleAnswer: I don’t think his remarks are relevant to our discussion.
references: I don’t think his remarks are relevant to our discussion.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: be relevant to“与……有关；切题”；英语习惯把否定放在 think 上：I don’t think ...。

q63.sampleAnswer: All the people present were moved at his remark.
references: All the people present were moved at his remark.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: remark 作名词“话语”；“在场的人”= the people present，present 放在名词后。

q64.sampleAnswer: It’s not reliable to judge a man only by his looks.
references: It’s not reliable to judge a man only by his looks.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: 用 it 作形式主语：It’s not reliable to do sth.“做某事是不可靠的”；“容貌”= looks。

q65.sampleAnswer: I felt great relief when I heard I had passed the examination.
references: I felt great relief when I heard I had passed the examination.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “如释重负”= feel great relief，relief 是名词；考试通过在“得知”之前，用过去完成时 had passed。
